text.en: Rash appeared about one day after 60 mL intra-arterial iodixanol; other newly prescribed cardiovascular medicines were also stopped at different times.

text.zh-CN: 造影示冠脉三支病变，团队曾说明停心脏药的风险。
text.en: Angiography showed three-vessel disease and the team discussed risks of withholding cardiac medication.

text.zh-CN: 原报告后期加强治疗，2 天后唇肿及瘙痒有所改善，随后离院；完整恢复、皮肤最终分型及长期结局未知。
text.en: Later treatment was intensified and lip swelling/itching partly improved over two days before departure. Complete recovery, final skin classification and long-term outcome are unknown.

prompt.zh-CN: 什么最使此皮疹超出轻症范围？
prompt.en: What makes this more than a mild rash?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 黏膜破溃、进食困难与水疱提示严重皮肤反应风险
text.en: Mucosal erosions, feeding difficulty and blistering suggest a severe cutaneous reaction

feedback.zh-CN: 不能只按瘙痒程度判断。
feedback.en: Severity is not measured by itching alone.

text.zh-CN: 嗜酸细胞不高即可排除药物反应
text.en: Low eosinophils exclude a drug reaction

feedback.zh-CN: 严重反应不要求嗜酸增多。

text.zh-CN: 等渗非离子造影剂不会过敏
text.en: Iso-osmolar nonionic contrast cannot cause hypersensitivity

feedback.zh-CN: 此类制剂仍可发生反应。
feedback.en: These agents can still cause reactions.

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 紧急皮肤/过敏团队评估黏膜、眼及全身受累，与心脏团队平衡停药风险
text.en: Urgent dermatology/allergy review of mucosal, ocular and systemic involvement with cardiology medication-risk balancing

feedback.zh-CN: 需要严重反应照护与多药时序核对。
feedback.en: Severe-reaction care and full medication chronology are needed.

text.zh-CN: 只增加一种抗组胺药后等待
text.en: Add one antihistamine and wait

feedback.zh-CN: 黏膜和水疱信号需要升级。
feedback.en: Mucosal and blistering signs require escalation.

text.zh-CN: 未经协作永久停掉全部心脏药
text.en: Permanently stop every cardiac drug without review

feedback.zh-CN: 三支病变带来重要竞争风险。
feedback.en: Three-vessel disease creates important competing risk.

prompt.zh-CN: 对未来造影应怎样记录？
prompt.en: How should future contrast use be documented?

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 记录具体碘克沙醇疑似严重迟发反应，避免自行再激发并专科评估替代
text.en: Record the specific suspected severe delayed iodixanol reaction; avoid unsupervised rechallenge and seek specialist alternatives

feedback.zh-CN: 不能简单写“碘过敏”并遗漏反应表型。
feedback.en: A vague “iodine allergy” loses the reaction phenotype.

text.zh-CN: 重新给原药以确定因果
text.en: Give the same agent again to prove causality

feedback.zh-CN: 严重皮肤反应不应以危险再激发求证。
feedback.en: Dangerous rechallenge is inappropriate to establish causality.

text.zh-CN: 已证实所有含碘物质都禁用
text.en: Every iodine-containing substance is proven contraindicated

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 造影后严重迟发皮肤黏膜反应，碘克沙醇为可疑药物，但多药暴露与分型缺失需保留。
conclusion.en: A severe delayed mucocutaneous reaction after angiography, with iodixanol suspected but competing exposures and incomplete classification retained.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 黏膜和水疱是升级信号。
keyReasoning.en: Mucosal lesions and blisters are escalation signals.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: ESUR 2025 强调按反应表型记录及后续专科评估。
keyReasoning.en: ESUR 2025 emphasises reaction phenotype documentation and specialist review.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 不要把旧文“激素不足”解释当作已证实唯一原因。
keyReasoning.en: Do not treat the source’s “insufficient steroids” explanation as a proven sole cause.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.

unknowns.zh-CN: 活检、脱皮面积、眼部专科结果、最终恢复与确定致敏药未载。
unknowns.en: Biopsy, detachment extent, ophthalmic findings, full recovery and a definitive culprit are absent.
